items.title: Electron runtime contract exists
items.evidence: src/lib/runtime/desktop/desktop-host-contract.ts — 12 privileges, deployment assumptions (electron>=28, sandbox=true, contextIsolation=true), exclusive vs shared feature lists.

items.title: Preload bridge is typed and minimal
items.evidence: electron/preload.cjs (22 methods) ↔ src/lib/runtime/desktop/electron-bridge-contract.ts BRIDGE_METHOD_REGISTRY (22 entries) — exact 1:1 cross-validation.

items.title: Native privileges only flow through approved bridge
items.evidence: contextIsolation=true + sandbox=true + nodeIntegration=false in electron/main.cjs webPreferences. Renderer pages forbidden from importing electron/* directly.

items.title: File-system bridge is explicit and permissioned
items.evidence: electron/fs-bridge.cjs — dialog-gated user consent, allowlist of file extensions, 50MB read cap, sandboxed userData/backups directory.

items.title: Auto-updater works or is clearly disabled
items.evidence: electron/auto-updater.cjs — graceful fallback when electron-updater missing, manual feed via SITA_UPDATE_URL, full lifecycle in desktop-update-contract.ts.

items.title: Crash reporting works
items.evidence: electron/crash-reporter.cjs — crashReporter.start, captures unhandledRejection / uncaughtException / render-process-gone, persists JSON dumps to userData/crash-reports/.

items.title: Native notifications work
items.evidence: electron/main.cjs — Notification.isSupported() gate + send-notification IPC channel; preload exposes sendNotification(title, body).

items.title: OS shell features are truthfully scoped
items.evidence: DESKTOP_HOST_CONTRACT enumerates 12 privileges, DESKTOP_EXCLUSIVE_FEATURES (10) vs DESKTOP_WEB_SHARED_FEATURES (2) cleanly separated; no over-claim of OS authority (Tier 2, not honest OS).

items.title: Desktop-specific release/build pipeline exists
items.evidence: scripts/release/desktop/build-electron.sh + electron/forge.config.cjs — cross-platform packaging via @electron/packager (linux/darwin/win32, x64/arm64).

items.title: Unsupported web-only/native-only mismatches are handled
items.evidence: src/lib/runtime/desktop/desktop-fallbacks.ts — every desktop-exclusive capability declares a web fallback strategy (web-api / no-op / cloud-alternative / download-blob).

items.title: App signing/notarization plan exists
items.evidence: electron/forge.config.cjs declares osxSign, osxNotarize, windowsSign blocks driven by env (APPLE_IDENTITY, APPLE_ID, APPLE_PASSWORD, APPLE_TEAM_ID, CSC_LINK, CSC_KEY_PASSWORD). Signing is wired but requires real certificates at release time.
items.remediation: Provision Apple Developer ID Application certificate + Windows EV/OV code signing certificate; populate APPLE_* and CSC_* env vars in release CI.
